summary.text: Roberta Lange is a Democratic member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 7 in Clark County. She has served in the Senate since 2020 and as Assistant Majority Leader since 2023, and the legislature lists her as vice chair of the Senate Health and Wellness Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Lange was born in Lancaster, California, in 1957 and lists her occupation as a retired K-12 teacher.
Her page lists her membership in the Washington State Education Association from 1981 to 1995 and as a lifetime member of the Nevada State Education Association.

Lange chaired the Clark County Democratic Party from 2008 to 2011 and the Nevada State Democratic Party from 2011 to 2017, according to her page, which also lists her as a member of the Democratic National Committee from 2011 to 2017.
She was first elected to the Nevada Senate in November 2020.
